lion.d: large gregarious predatory feline of Africa and India having a tawny coat with a shaggy mane in the male

lionfish.d: brightly striped fish of the tropical Pacific having elongated spiny fins

liothyronine.d: thyroid hormone similar to thyroxine but with one less iodine atom per molecule and produced in smaller quantity; exerts the same biological effects as thyroxine but is more potent and brief

lion monkey.d: small South American marmoset with silky fur and long nonprehensile tail
